verdict.rationale: gstack maintains a CHANGELOG.md with detailed, user-facing release entries, such as polling behavior changes, pricing lanes and Claude snapshot billing (gstack-docs-33, gstack-docs-52, gstack-docs-53). Its /gstack-upgrade skill explicitly 'shows what's new' (gstack-docs-7), so developers can see what changed in the skills. Missing for 10: evidence that the upgrade flow previews changes before applying them rather than after, and independent or hands-on corroboration of changelog quality.
